_twist: Comic/Pop-Art overhaul: replaced dark palette with bold primary palette. White page background, black outlines, comic red, comic yellow, cyan blue, panel yellow. Flat fills only — no gradients.

visual.description: Pure white — the comic book page itself. Clean, bright, ready for panels and ink.
Bold black — the ink. Used for all text, borders, outlines, and hard offset shadows.
Primary accent red — action, energy, ZAP! Used on CTAs, feature highlights, and action panel backgrounds.
Primary yellow — the classic comic background color. Used for hero, nav bar, speech bubbles, and highlight panels.
Ben-Day cyan blue — comic printing's signature blue. Used for secondary panels, testimonial bubbles, and feature cards.
Light yellow — warm panel background for content sections. Softer than #ffeb3b for body text readability.
Pale blue panel background variant. Used for alternating cards and section tints.
Pale red panel background variant. Used for error states and alternating card backgrounds.

ctaButtons.note: Comic red filled — the main action button. Hard offset shadow.
Yellow ghost — secondary action. Bold black border, yellow fill.
Black filled — for use on yellow/light backgrounds.
Cyan — for tertiary actions and feature section CTAs.
